$about: Canonical analog design tokens. Edit ONLY this file, then run `node app/shared/design/generate.mjs`. See README.md.

color.$about: Warm blacks and softly tinted neutrals — never pure black, never pure white. R > G > B on every neutral.

grain.$about: Fine, low-contrast film grain over the stage. Must never reduce text or artwork clarity.

poster.$about: Square, unrounded artwork at EVERY size — including skeletons, placeholders, season cards and selected states. radiusPx is 0 and is asserted by tests in both clients.

selection.$about: Depth through scale, framing, light and position. No perspective tilt, no bounce.

elevation.$about: Directional cast shadows keyed to sceneLightAngleDeg (light above-left => shadow below-right).

motion.$about: Mechanical and weighty: short travel, clear detents, restrained easing. No elastic overshoot anywhere.

hairline.$about: Timeline and volume are precision lines, not filled bars. The visible line is thin; the hit target is not.

timing.$about: Behavioural constants fixed by the design references; the interaction cores in app/shared/design/interaction.json are driven by these same numbers.

radius.$about: Artwork is always square. These radii are for chrome only (buttons, sheets, toasts) and must never be applied to a poster, still, skeleton or placeholder.

z.$about: Stage layering. The player owns its own bands; these are the browse shell.
